scope: Generated bounded native observations using existing host bindings; neither completeness nor greenfield harness construction.
timing_caveat: Phase stamps mark tool switches and file operations. Some patch preparation preceded a start stamp; these are not isolated per-class authoring times. Only subprocess stopwatches are measured per-class command costs; engineering time is reported as a gross observed workflow window, with any per-row allocation explicitly modeled.
classification_correction: Initial2826scenario-priced count included1040 unknowncalls; withdrawing them left1786. Withdrawing21 unknownconstructors leaves final1765scenario-priced/5576unpriced. Earlier counts are not used for final extrapolation.

declared_measurement_scope.all: Bounded generated corpus; no arbitrary JS objects/proxies, live network, deployment/runtime scheduling exhaustiveness, external child-library correctness, platform universality or complete-function argument. Existing host code and already-ported targets are reused.
declared_measurement_scope.utilities: Materialized lone-surrogate strings, unbounded array lengths/depth and arbitrary coercion objects excluded. Positive token arrays end at32.
declared_measurement_scope.record: Declared positive string fields only; actual source consumer executes but erased interface has no runtime validator. Unknown-property/alias equivalence and lone-surrogate domain excluded.
declared_measurement_scope.http: Finite numeric current-response data or injected network error only. Every call has an explicitly excluded TS eager/Rust lazy prefix difference; awaited outcomes and selected request/failure fields only.
declared_measurement_scope.orchestration: Actual venue bodies with supplied Base/store/HTTP/signing/socket/clock protocols and bounded ready-task executor. Recursive native values/traces/state are compared; pointer/alias relations and complete scheduling histories are not established. NaN class equality is separate from payload/sign-bit equality.

initial_utility_run.note: Exploratory combined three-row target before row-selective source execution and input guards. Cargo reported time, not a separate subprocess stopwatch. Package-cache lock was observed.

capture_fault.observation: Cross-realm VM Map failed instanceof Map; entries were encoded as empty object fields. New native state comparison failed at markets/0/state/marketMetadata. Fixed actual encoder; source-map-erasure control reinstates this exact failure mode.

earlier_observations.initial_failures: HTTP fixture used unsupported RestFailure::default; venue target initially had opaque-future match and log-type compile errors. Logs preserved in attempt-history, not credited as discriminating controls.

sampling_caveat: Nine purposive existing Polymarket rows, not an IID sample or newly verified complete functions. Syntactic routing is a conditional cost model; no measured population means or probability of parity. All unpriced rows retain unknown cost.

integration_update.effect: Incoming history also changed shared HTTP/transport behavior and included Polymarket HTTP fixtures. All nine positives, controls and warm timings are rerun after merge. Pre-merge results remain archived and do not establish current behavior. Required shipping gates increased from three to four including fmt.
